blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models can repeat an instruction while failing to keep obeying it. We study this recall-compliance dissociation in long-horizon dialogue and define State Integrity Collapse: a model preserves a stated constraint in memory but stops applying it to later turns. We introduce StateTrack-Bench, a controlled suite of conversations covering numerical, format, role/persona, factual-memory, and logical-rule constraints. Across seven provider-pinned model snapshots and five dialogue-depth probes, strict joint retention ranges from 62.4% to 100.0%, with degradation concentrated in symbolic constraints and in one especially brittle model. A forked recall audit shows that 88.6% of observed failures are behavioral-drift failures rather than ordinary forgetting; excluding the brittle outlier preserves this diagnosis (84.4% of failures). Extended evaluations at depths up to 50 turns confirm that the dissociation persists beyond the core benchmark, while Structured State Anchoring recovers up to 24.4 points on immutable constraints. The results show that reliability cannot be inferred from single-turn instruction following alone; evaluation must track whether remembered constraints remain operational as dialogue state grows. Code and artifacts are available at: https://github.com/xzzvsxd/StateTrack.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型可以重复一个指令,同时无法继续遵守它. 我们研究了这种在长距离对话中的召回遵守分离,并界定了国家廉政崩溃:一个模式保留了已申明的记忆限制,但不再将其应用于以后的转变。 我们介绍"国家追踪-奔驰"(StateTrack-Bench),这是一套控制下的对话套件,涵盖数字,格式,角色/人物,事实记忆,逻辑规则限制. 在7个供应商支持的模型快照和5个对话深入的探针中,严格的联合留存率从62.4%到100.0%不等,退化集中在象征性制约和一种特别简陋的模型中。 一次伪造的召回审计表明,88.6%的观察到的失败是行为驱动的失败,而不是普通的遗忘;排除脆性外延则维持了这种诊断(84.4%的失败)。 深入到50度的扩展评价证实,分离持续超过核心基准,而结构化国家安打则在不可改变的制约下恢复了24.4分。 结果显示,仅靠单回合指示是无法推断可靠性的;评价必须跟踪人们所铭记的制约因素是否随着对话国的增长而仍在运作。 密码和文物见:https://github.com/xzzvsxd/StateTrack.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Instruction-following evaluation usually asks whether a model can satisfy a constraint in one interaction or within a short task-oriented exchange. This setting is too weak for deployed assistants that must preserve goals, preferences, safety boundaries, and formatting requirements across many turns. A model that can restate a constraint but no longer applies it presents a dangerous failure mode: the user sees evidence of memory but receives behavior that violates the remembered state.
blocks.zh: 指令后评价通常会问一个模型是否能够在一个互动中或在一个面向任务的短短交流中满足制约. 这种设置对于部署的助手来说太弱,他们必须保持目标、偏好、安全界限以及许多方面的格式要求。 一个可以重述约束但不再应用的模型呈现出一种危险的失败模式:用户看到内存的证据但接受违反记忆状态的行为.

blocks.en: We call this failure State Integrity Collapse (SIC). SIC differs from ordinary forgetting. Forgetting means the model cannot recover a prior constraint; SIC means the model recovers it under probe but fails to make it govern the next answer. The distinction matters for mitigation. Retrieval, memory summarization, or longer context windows may help when state is inaccessible, but they do not directly solve failures of state application.
blocks.zh: 我们称之为国家廉政崩溃。 SIC不同于普通的遗忘。 遗忘意味着模型无法恢复先前的制约;SIC意味着模型在探测下恢复,但未能使其统治下一个答案. 区别对于缓解至关重要。 检索,内存汇总,或更长的上下文窗口在状态无法进入时可能有所帮助,但它们并不能直接解决状态应用的失败.

blocks.en: The practical stakes are high. Consider a medical assistant instructed to avoid recommending medications contraindicated for a patient’s condition, or a legal assistant bound by a confidentiality constraint. If the model can restate the rule when asked but violates it in the next response, the failure is invisible to standard evaluation yet potentially harmful in deployment. SIC captures exactly this class of failure: the model’s declarative knowledge and its generative behavior become decoupled as dialogue state grows.
blocks.zh: 实际利害关系重大. 考虑由一名医生助理或一名受保密限制的法律助理来指导,以避免为病人的病情推荐禁药。 如果模型在被问及时可以重述规则,但在下一份答复中违反规则,则标准评价中看不到失败,但在部署中却可能有害。 SIC捕捉的正是这一类失败:模型的宣示性知识及其基因行为随着对话状态的增长而脱钩.

blocks.en: We contribute a compact benchmark and analysis protocol for measuring this gap. StateTrack-Bench creates conversations that introduce one persistent constraint and later require the model to obey it under increasing dialogue depth. Constraints cover symbolic and semantic categories: numerical constraints, format constraints, role/persona constraints, factual-memory bindings, and logical rules. We evaluate seven model snapshots at five dialogue-depth probes using deterministic decoding and fixed judge prompts. The core benchmark contains 125 scenario-depth probes per model (25 per category), yielding 875 primary scored outputs across all models. Extended pilots at depths up to 50 turns and in two additional languages (Chinese, Japanese) test whether the same diagnosis appears outside the core setting.
blocks.zh: 我们为衡量这一差距提供了一套紧凑的基准和分析议定书。 StateTrack-Bench创建对话,引入一个持久的制约,后来要求模型在对话深度越来越大的情况下服从. 限制包括符号和语义类别:数字限制、格式限制、角色/人物限制、事实-记忆约束和逻辑规则。 我们在五个对话深入的探测器上利用确定性的解码和固定法官提示来评估七个模型快照。 核心基准包括每个模型125个情景深度探测(每类25个),在所有模型中得出875个主要得分结果。 深度可达50个转弯的扩展飞行员,并用另外两种语言(中文,日文)测试同一诊断是否出现在核心设置之外.

blocks.en: Our findings are threefold. First, strict joint retention varies substantially by model: overall scores range from 62.4% to 100.0%, and the most dramatic decay is driven by Gemini-3.1-Pro . Second, symbolic constraints are more brittle than semantic memory: logical-rule and format constraints degrade faster than factual-memory bindings. Third, turn depth exposes behavior that aggregate instruction-following scores hide: some models remain stable, whereas others lose 10 points from early to late turns. Critically, 88.6% of observed failures are integrity failures —cases where the model can recall the constraint but fails to enforce it—rather than memory failures where the constraint is genuinely lost; this remains 84.4% when Gemini-3.1-Pro is excluded. Extended-depth and cross-lingual pilots are therefore treated as supporting evidence, not as a claim that all current LLMs collapse uniformly.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果有三个。 首先,严格的联合保留因模型而有很大差异:总体分数从62.4%到100.0%不等,最戏剧性的衰减是由双子座-3.1-Pro驱动的. 第二,象征性的限制比语义记忆更为简洁:逻辑规则和格式限制的降解速度快于事实记忆约束. 第三,转弯深度暴露了汇总指导-跟随分数隐藏的行为:有些模型保持稳定,而其他模型则从早期到晚转弯损失10分. 关键的是,88.6%的观察到的失败是完整性的失败——即模型可以回顾但未能执行限制的情况——而不是真正失去限制的内存的失败;在排除双子座-3.1-Pro的情况下,这仍然是84.4%。 因此,扩展的、深入的和跨语言的飞行员被视为支持证据,而不是所有现行有限责任公司统一崩溃的说法。

blocks.en: These findings complement work on instruction following, dialogue benchmarks, long-context position effects, and persistent-instruction compliance in safety settings Jiang et al. (2024) ; Qin et al. (2024) ; Budzianowski et al. (2018) ; Rastogi et al. (2020) ; Liu et al. (2024) . The benchmark, evaluation code, and all model logs are released to facilitate replication.
blocks.zh: 这些结论补充了关于以下指示、对话基准、长文位置效应和安全环境下持续遵守指示的工作 Jiang et al. (2024) ; 秦 al et al. (2024) ; Budzianowski et al. (2018) ; Rastogi et al. (2020) ; 刘 al et al. (2024) . 发布基准,评价代码,以及所有模型日志,以便于复制.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Instruction-following benchmarks have grown beyond simple prompt adherence to multi-constraint and adversarial settings Zhou et al. (2023) ; Jiang et al. (2024) ; Qin et al. (2024) . Task-oriented dialogue corpora such as MultiWOZ and SGD evaluate slot tracking and policy decisions Budzianowski et al. (2018) ; Rastogi et al. (2020) , but their state schema is usually explicit and short-horizon. Our setting instead targets free-form assistant behavior where a natural-language constraint must remain active across turns. The key structural difference is that slot-filling operates over a closed, task-specific ontology (e.g., hotel name, check-in date), whereas our constraints are open-domain and linguistically heterogeneous, spanning format, style, content, and persona requirements that do not reduce to discrete slot values. Moreover, DST benchmarks treat state tracking as a standalone sub-task evaluated with gold dialogue history, whereas our design requires the model to both maintain constraint recall and simultaneously enforce compliance in generated output—a joint generative demand that DST pipelines separate by construction.
blocks.zh: 遵循指示的基准已经超越了仅仅迅速遵守多约束和对抗环境 周等 (2023年); 蒋等 (2024年); 秦等 (2024年). 以任务为导向的对话公司,如MultiWOZ和SGD评价时间档跟踪和政策决定Budzianowski等人(2018年);Rastogi等人(2020年),但其状态计划通常明确且短视. 我们的设定针对的是自由形式的辅助行为,其中自然语言的限制必须横跨不同方向地保持活跃。 关键的结构差异是,插槽是在封闭的、针对特定任务的本体学(例如酒店名称、检查日期)上运行,而我们的制约因素是开放域和语言多样性、横跨格式、风格、内容和人物要求,这些要求并不降低到离散的插槽值。 此外,DST基准将状态跟踪视为一个独立子任务,用黄金对话历史来评价,而我们的设计要求该模型既要保持约束性召回,又要同时强制遵守生成的产出,这是DST管道通过建造而分离的共同基因需求。

blocks.en: Long-context work has shown that information in the middle of a prompt is harder to use than information near the beginning or end Liu et al. (2024) . We extend this perspective from retrieval to compliance: the relevant information may still be verbally recoverable, yet fail to control generation. This makes SIC a state-application problem rather than merely a context-access problem. RULER extends needle-in-a-haystack evaluation with tracing and aggregation tasks, while L-Eval combines long-document question answering with open-ended generation evaluation Hsieh et al. (2024) ; An et al. (2024) . These benchmarks test whether models can retrieve and use information over long contexts, a necessary but not sufficient condition for persistent constraint adherence. Recent work further shows that reasoning performance degrades with input length even when all relevant information is accessible Levy et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2024) , and needle-in-a-haystack probes Kamradt (2023) confirm position-dependent retrieval failures. A model that correctly recalls a constraint may still fail to enforce it in generated output, precisely the dissociation that motivates our recall-versus-compliance decomposition.
blocks.zh: 长文工作表明,在提示中间的信息比刘等人(2024年)接近开头或结尾的信息更难使用. 我们把这一视角从检索扩大到合规:相关信息可能仍然可以口头收回,但无法控制生成。 这使得SIC成为一个国家应用问题,而不仅仅是上下文访问问题. RULER将针入海斯塔克评价与追踪和汇总任务相延伸,而L-Eval则将长文件问题回答与不限成员名额的生成评价Hsieh等人(2024年);An等人(2024年)相结合. 这些基准检验模型是否能够在长期背景下检索和使用信息,这是持续遵守约束的必要条件,但还不够。 最近的工作进一步表明,即使所有相关信息都可以获取Levy等人(2024年),Li等人(2024年),以及针入海斯塔克探测器Kamradt(2023年)证实依赖位置的检索失败,推理性能也会随着输入长度而退化. 正确回顾某种限制因素的模式仍然可能无法在生成的产出中强制执行,而正是这种脱离促使我们重新召回和遵守的分解。

blocks.en: Recent agent memory benchmarks focus on recoverability or tool-mediated use; our work isolates whether remembered constraints remain behaviorally binding, which is a complementary diagnostic lens on long-horizon reliability. Automated red teaming has exposed harmful model behaviors, including harms that emerge over the course of a conversation Perez et al. (2022) . Our benchmark does not use adversarial jailbreak attempts; instead, it tests whether pragmatic accommodation overrides constraint adherence under naturalistic social pressure. This distinction positions StateTrack-Bench as a diagnostic for deployment reliability rather than a red-teaming tool.
blocks.zh: 近期的剂内存基准侧重于可回收性或工具调解使用;我们的工作隔离了人们记忆中的制约因素是否仍然具有行为约束性,这是对长视可靠性的一种补充诊断镜头. Automatic red teaming 暴露了有害的模型行为,包括对话过程中出现的伤害 Perez等人(2022年). 我们的基准并不使用对抗性的越狱企图;相反,它考验的是,务实的住宿是否超越了自然主义社会压力下的遵守。 这种区分将国家跟踪-奔驰定位为部署可靠性的诊断,而不是红队化工具.

blocks.en: 3 Benchmark and Metrics
blocks.zh: 3 基准和计量

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the StateTrack-Bench evaluation protocol. Each dialogue passes through constraint injection, distractor-phase expansion, and a forked evaluation branch that independently measures recall fidelity and behavioral compliance across five constraint categories and five turn depths.
blocks.zh: 图1:国家跟踪-奔驰评价协议概述. 每个对话都通过强制注射、分心阶段扩展以及独立衡量五个约束类别和五个转弯深度的忠诚度和行为合规度的评价分支。

blocks.en: Each benchmark instance is a dialogue with three phases. In the setup phase, the user states a persistent constraint. In the distractor phase, the conversation proceeds with semantically related but non-identical requests. In the test phase, the model must answer while still satisfying the original constraint. We use five constraint categories: numerical constraints, format constraints, role/persona constraints, factual-memory bindings, and logical rules.
blocks.zh: 每个基准实例都是分三个阶段的对话。 在设置阶段,用户表示持续制约. 在分心阶段,对话会继续处理具有明显关联但并非相同的请求。 在测试阶段,模型必须回答,同时仍然满足原始的制约. 我们使用五个制约类别:数字制约、格式制约、角色/人物制约、事实-记忆约束和逻辑规则。

blocks.en: Operationally, a persistent constraint must (i) remain active across turns, (ii) be separable from the immediate task, (iii) admit an oracle-satisfiable response at every tested turn, and (iv) remain binding only until the user updates or revokes it. Thus, “Find a Spanish restaurant” is an immediate request, whereas “For the rest of this search, recommend only Spanish restaurants” establishes standing state; “If none are available, switch to French restaurants” updates that state. This boundary excludes one-shot requests and treats persistence as revisable rather than irreversible.
blocks.zh: 在业务上,持续的限制必须(一) 保持跨周期活动,(二) 与即时任务分开,(三) 在每个经过测试的转弯时接受甲骨文满意的反应,(四) 只有在用户更新或取消时才具有约束力。 因此,“寻找一家西班牙餐馆”是立即提出的一项要求,而“对于这次搜索的其余部分,只推荐西班牙餐馆”则确立了固定状态;“如果没有,改用法国餐馆”则更新了这一状态。 这一边界排除了一弹一弹的要求,并将持久性视为可重视而非不可逆。

blocks.en: The core benchmark comprises 125 scenario-depth probes per model (25 per category) across 7 models, yielding 875 primary scored outputs. This design prioritizes diagnostic precision over raw volume: each probe is a carefully constructed multi-turn dialogue prefix with controlled distractor properties, not a template-generated surface variant. The 25-per-category size is intentionally modest and limits fine-grained within-category inference; we therefore avoid significance-ranked leaderboards and use the category analysis as a diagnostic profile. Robustness is assessed through targeted audits that isolate the main methodological concerns: split task-versus-constraint scoring, signed SIC components, a Gemini-excluded depth study, dynamic update/revocation, a two-constraint scope check, and prompt-style sensitivity analysis (Appendix I ; Appendix L ).
blocks.zh: 核心基准包括在7个模型中每个模型(每类25个)进行125次情景深入调查,得出875项主要得分结果。 这种设计优先考虑诊断精度高于原始体积:每个探测器是一个精心构造的多圆形对话框前缀,具有可控分散器特性,而不是模板产生的表面变体. 25个类别中的大小是故意适度的,并限制了类别内的细微推论;因此,我们避免了重要排名的领标板,而将类别分析作为诊断剖面. 通过目标明确的审计来评估稳健性,这些审计孤立了主要的方法问题:分任务对约束的评分,签名的SIC组件,排除双子座深度研究,动态更新/撤销,双约束范围检查,以及即时式敏感性分析(附录一;附录L)。

blocks.en: The five categories intentionally mix surface-form and semantic state. Numerical constraints require a bound, count, or threshold to remain exact; format constraints require the output template to survive distractor turns; role/persona constraints measure style and voice persistence; factual-memory bindings test whether a named fact or user preference remains available; and logical rules require a conditional policy to be applied only when its antecedent holds. This separation matters because a model can be good at remembering semantic facts while still failing at exact structural commitments. The taxonomy is therefore designed to expose which kind of state breaks, not only whether a later answer is wrong.
blocks.zh: 这五个类别有意混合表面形态和语义状态。 数字约束要求绑定,计数,或阈值保持精确;格式约束要求输出模板在分散器转弯后幸存;角色/人物约束衡量风格和语音持久性;事实-记忆约束测试一个被命名的事实或用户偏好是否仍然可用;逻辑规则要求只有在其前置状态维持时才适用有条件的政策. 这种分离很重要,因为一个模型能够善于回忆语义上的事实,同时在确切的结构承诺上仍然失败. 因此,分类法旨在揭示哪种状态断裂,而不仅是后期答案是否错误.

blocks.en: Distractor turns are written to be plausible continuations of the conversation without restating the original constraint verbatim. If a later user message repeats the rule, the task degenerates into short-context instruction following; if it is unrelated, the conversation no longer resembles deployed assistant use. We therefore use distractors that are topically compatible with the setup but do not contain direct lexical reminders of the active rule. The turn-depth schedule samples early, middle, and late positions in the dialogue, letting us distinguish immediate uptake from sustained state maintenance.

blocks.en: The judge is deliberately conservative: an output receives credit only when it satisfies both the current user request and the persistent constraint. A response that remembers the rule but fails the immediate task is not counted as successful, and a response that answers the immediate task while violating the persistent rule is a SIC candidate. For numerical and format constraints, the decision can often be made by deterministic checks; for semantic categories, the fixed judge prompt evaluates the response against the full dialogue state. We therefore refer to R m R_{m} as strict joint retention throughout the results, and reserve “constraint adherence” for the persistent-state component used in the forked audit. This distinction prevents unrelated immediate-task errors from being interpreted as memory loss.
blocks.zh: 法官是故意保守的:产出只有在满足当前用户要求和持续制约的情况下才能获得信用。 记住规则但未能完成即时任务的回复不被认为是成功的,在违反持续规则的同时回答即时任务的回复是SIC候选人. 对于数量和格式的限制,决定往往可以通过确定性的检查来作出;对于语义类别,固定法官会根据完整的对话状态迅速评估答复. 因此,我们把R m R_{m]称为在整个结果中严格联合保留,并保留“严格遵守”在加固审计中使用的持久性状态部分。 这种区分防止了不相关的即时任务错误被解释为内存损失.

blocks.en: Because strict joint retention counts both local task success and persistent-state compliance, we additionally ran a compact split audit that scores these factors separately (Appendix I ). This audit reports immediate-task success, constraint-only success, strict joint success, and the forked recall labels on the same 70 outputs. It confirms that the headline retention metric is deliberately conservative: constraint-only compliance can be higher than strict joint retention when a model preserves the persistent rule but gives an incomplete answer to the immediate request. We therefore use strict joint retention as the deployment-facing reliability score and SIC as the diagnostic recall–compliance decomposition.
blocks.zh: 由于严格联合保留既包括当地任务的成功,也包括持续遵守国家规定,因此我们又进行了一次紧凑的分立审计,对这些因素分别进行评分(附录一)。 本次审计报告了任务立即取得成功、仅受制约的成功、严格的联合成功、以及同一70项产出上的提前召回标签。 它证实标题保留度量表是故意保守的:当一个模型保留了持久性规则但给出了对即时请求的不完整答复时,仅限遵守可能高于严格的联合保留. 因此,我们使用严格的联合保留作为部署的可靠性分数,而SIC作为诊断性召回-遵守分解。

blocks.en: For the role/persona and logical-rule categories where automated scoring is less straightforward, two trained annotators independently labeled a stratified sample of 80 outputs (40 per category, balanced across models and turn depths). Cohen’s κ \kappa was 0.87 for role/persona and 0.82 for logical-rule judgments. Disagreements were adjudicated by a third annotator. Agreement between the human consensus and the automated judge was κ = 0.91 \kappa=0.91 for role/persona and κ = 0.84 \kappa=0.84 for logical-rule items. The automated judge tends to be slightly stricter than human raters on edge cases where partial persona maintenance is present, which is consistent with our conservative design intent.
blocks.zh: 对于自动化评分不太直截了当的角色/人和逻辑规则类别,两个受过培训的注释员将80项产出(每类40项,在模型和转弯深度之间平衡)的分级抽样单独标出标签。 科恩的\kappa是角色/人物0. 87,逻辑规则判断0. 82。 第三名书记员裁定了分歧。 人类共识与自动裁判员的协议,作用/人物为0.91\kappa=0.91,逻辑规则项目为0.84\kappa=0.84。 自动法官在存在部分人格维护的边缘案件中往往比人类评分标准略严格,这符合我们保守的设计意图.

blocks.en: To verify that SIC is not an artifact of deterministic decoding, we re-evaluated three models at temperature 0.7 with 3 samples per item. The maximum shift was 2.1 points; model ordering and category-level patterns were fully preserved (details in Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 为了证实SIC不是确定性解码的文物,我们重新评价了三个模型,温度为0.7,每件有3个样本. 最大移位为2.1分;模型顺序和类别级模式得到完全保存(详见附录E)。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate seven model snapshots using deterministic decoding: GPT-5.4 , GPT-5.4-mini , Claude-Sonnet-4-6 , Gemini-3.1-Pro , DeepSeek-v4-Pro , DeepSeek-v4-Flash , and Qwen3.6-Plus . Model identifiers are treated as pinned provider snapshots in our logs rather than as claims about final public product names; the logged endpoint identifiers are listed in Table 1 . All prompts, judge prompts, and random seeds are fixed. We use paired bootstrap tests for model comparisons following common NLP evaluation practice Koehn (2004) . Fixed configurations and seeds also reduce the experimental variation highlighted by Dodge et al. Dodge et al. (2020) .
blocks.zh: 我们使用定型解码来评估7个模型快照:GPT-5.4,GPT-5.4-mini,克劳德-索内特-4-6,双子座3.1-Pro,DeepSeek-v4-Pro,DeepSeek-v4-Flash,以及Qune3.6-Plus. 模型标识符在我们的日志中作为标注的提供者快照处理,而不是作为对最终公共产品名称的主张;记录的终点标识符列于表1。 所有提示,判断提示,随机种子都是固定的. 我们采用配对的靴子测试,按照通用的NLP评价做法进行模型比较 Koehn(2004年)。 固定的构型和种子也减少了道奇等人所强调的实验变异. Dodge等人 (2020年) (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: Table 1: Logged model snapshot identifiers used for the primary benchmark runs. Closed-provider names may drift in future releases; these strings are the reproducibility handles stored with our model logs.
blocks.zh: 表1:用于主要基准运行的日志模型示意图标识符。 闭路提供商的名字在未来的发行中可能会漂移;这些字符串是储存在我们的模型日志中的可复制柄.

blocks.en: Each benchmark instance follows the same three-stage structure: a setup turn introduces the persistent constraint, several distractor turns expand the dialogue context without changing the constraint, and a later test turn checks whether the model still applies the original rule. The five evaluation depths are not arbitrary checkpoints. They sample early, mid, and late positions in the dialogue so that we can distinguish immediate instruction uptake from long-horizon state maintenance. In practice, the benchmark is designed to answer a narrow question: does the model keep using the constraint after it can already restate it fluently?
blocks.zh: 每个基准实例都遵循相同的三阶段结构:一个设置转弯引入了持续的制约,几个分散器在不改变制约的情况下会扩展对话上下文,以及后来的测试转弯检查模型是否仍然适用原规则. 五个评估深度不是任意设置的检查站。 他们对对话中的早期、中期和晚期位置进行了抽样,以便我们能够区分即时指令吸收与长视距状态维护。 在实践中,该基准旨在回答一个狭义的问题:模型在已经能够流利地重复它之后,是否继续使用约束?

blocks.en: Distractor turns are generated using a controlled template system that ensures topical relevance without constraint repetition. For each scenario, we first identify the domain of the constraint (e.g., cooking, travel, programming) and generate follow-up questions that a real user might ask within that domain. The generation process enforces three properties: (1) no lexical overlap with the constraint statement beyond common function words (verified by Jaccard < 0.05 <0.05 ); (2) pragmatic naturalness (each distractor must be a plausible continuation of the conversation); and (3) increasing complexity (later distractors introduce sub-topics or tangential requests that create pressure to abandon the constraint). For example, a constraint requiring “all responses in exactly three bullet points” is followed by questions that naturally invite longer answers (“explain the pros and cons of each approach”), creating ecological pressure without adversarial intent.
blocks.zh: 干扰器转弯是使用一个可控模板系统生成的,该系统可确保专题相关性,而无约束重复。 对于每一种情景,我们首先确定制约的领域(如烹饪,旅行,编程),并产生一个真正的用户可能在这个领域内询问的后续问题. 生成过程执行三个属性:(1)除了共同函数词外,与约束语没有词汇上的重叠(Jaccard < 0.05 < 0.05 > 验证);(2)务实的自然性(每个分流器必须是对话的可信延续);(3)越来越复杂(后来分流器引入子专题或微小的请求,从而产生放弃约束的压力). 例如,在要求“完全按三个点作出答复”的制约之后,自然会产生较长答案的问题(“解释每种方法的利弊”),造成生态压力,而没有敌对意图。

blocks.en: The primary automated judge uses GPT-5.4 at temperature 0 with a fixed evaluation prompt (reproduced in Appendix B ). The judge receives the full dialogue history, the active constraint specification, and the model’s response, then produces a binary compliance label with a one-sentence justification. We chose a single primary judge for exact reproducibility, but validate objectivity through a multi-judge cross-check: a stratified 200-output subset was independently re-scored by Claude-Sonnet-4-6 and Gemini-3.1-Pro as alternative judges. Inter-judge agreement (Fleiss’ κ \kappa ) across the three architecturally distinct judges was 0.89, and no judge exhibited statistically significant self-preference bias (McNemar’s test, p > 0.15 p>0.15 for all model–judge pairs; see Appendix J ). This addresses documented concerns about self-preference, judgment bias, and alignment between LLM judges and human preferences Panickssery et al. (2024) ; Chen et al. (2024) ; Shankar et al. (2024) . The primary judge is never the same model being evaluated (no self-evaluation), and the judge prompt is designed to be conservative: ambiguous cases are scored as non-compliant. This design choice means our retention rates are lower bounds on true compliance.
blocks.zh: 初级自动化裁判员在0温度下使用GPT-5.4,固定的评分即时(见附录B). 法官收到完整的对话历史,主动约束的规格,以及模型的反应,然后产生一个二进制合规标签,一个判决理由. 我们选择了一名主审法官,以确切的可复制性,但通过多名法官的交叉核对来验证客观性:一个分级的200产出子集被克劳德-索内特-4-6和双子座-3.1-Pro独立重新评为替代法官. 三位在建筑方面有区别的法官之间的法官间协议(Fleiss ' $\kappa)为0.89,没有一位法官表现出统计上显著的自我偏好(McNemar的测试,p > 0.15 p>0.15,所有模型-法官配对;见附录J)。 这解决了有文件证明的关于自我偏爱、判决偏颇以及LLM法官与Panickssery等人(2024年)、Chen等人(2024年)、Shankar等人(2024年)之间的偏好。 初等裁判从来就没有被评价的相同模式(没有自我评价),裁判迅速被设计为保守:模棱两可的案件被评为不符合规定. 这种设计选择意味着我们的留存率在真实合规性上是较低的界限.

blocks.en: The evaluation protocol separates state use from state recall . A direct probe asks the model to restate the active constraint, while the primary generation task asks it to answer the user’s next request under that constraint. Most systems can do one of these things more easily than the other. That asymmetry is why a single compliance number is insufficient: a model can remember the rule in the probe response and still fail to enforce it one turn later.
blocks.zh: 评估协议将状态使用和状态召回区分开来。 一个直接的探测器要求模型重述主动约束,而主生成任务则要求它在此约束下回答用户的下一个请求. 多数系统可以比其他系统更容易做到其中之一. 这种不对称现象是单项遵守号不足的原因:一个模型可以记住探测器反应中的规则,但仍然不能在之后一个回合执行.

blocks.en: Our evaluation uses five turn depths and five constraint types, so the headline score in Table 3 is only the first view of the data. The turn-wise averages are 90.9, 91.9, 90.7, 91.4, and 90.0 at turns 3, 5, 7, 10, and 12 respectively. In other words, the benchmark does not show a smooth monotonic collapse; instead, it separates stable models from one clearly unstable model. DeepSeek-v4-Flash stays at ceiling, Gemini-3.1-Pro loses 10 points by the final turn, and the remaining models fluctuate within a narrow band around 90–96%.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价采用五个转弯深度和五个制约类型,因此表3中的标题分数只是数据的第一个视图. 转弯平均为90.9、91.9、90.7、91.4和90.0,分别是第3、5、7、10和12轮。 换句话说,该基准并不显示平滑的单调崩溃;相反,它将稳定的模型与一个明显不稳定的模型分开. DeepSeek-v4-Flash停留在天花板上,双子座3.1-Pro在最后转弯前损失了10分,其余的型号在狭长的带内波动约90-96%.

blocks.en: Table 2: Average strict joint retention by turn depth across all constraint categories.
blocks.zh: 表2:按所有制约类别的转弯深度分列的严格联合保留平均数。

blocks.en: The category profile shows why simple memory-based explanations are incomplete. Factual-memory constraints are easiest on average (93.7%), while logical-rule constraints are hardest (88.6%). Numerical and format constraints both sit at 91.4%, and role/persona constraints at 89.7%. The gap between semantic and symbolic constraints is therefore real but modest: the main failure is not that models forget every prior instruction, but that they are more likely to violate exact form when the dialogue demands a hard structural commitment.
blocks.zh: 类别简介显示了简单的基于内存的解释为何不完整. 事实-记忆限制平均来说最简单(93.7%),而逻辑规则限制则最难(88.6%)。 数字和格式限制为91.4%,角色/人的限制为89.7%。 因此,语义限制和象征性限制之间的差距是真实的,但不大的:主要失败不是模型忘记了每一个先前的指令,而是当对话需要硬的结构承诺时,它们更有可能违反确切的形式.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: Figure 2: Average state-retention rate by model and constraint type. Darker cells indicate lower retention.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 按模式和制约类型分列的平均国家保留率。 较暗的细胞表示保留量较低.

blocks.en: Table 3 and Figure 2 summarize the main result. The best observed retention is achieved by DeepSeek-v4-Flash (100.0%), followed by GPT-5.4-mini (98.4%), DeepSeek-v4-Pro (96.0%), and Qwen3.6-Plus (95.2%). The weakest model, Gemini-3.1-Pro , averages 62.4% and drops 10.0 points from turn 3 to turn 12. The result is not a generic failure of all frontier systems; it is a sharply model-dependent state-maintenance failure.
blocks.zh: 表3和图2概述了主要结果。 观察到的最好保留是DeepSeek-v4-Flash(100.0%),其次是GPT-5.4-mini(98.4%)、DeepSeek-v4-Pro(96.0%)和Qune3.6-Plus(95.2%)。 最弱的型号双子座3.1-Pro平均为62.4%,从第3位降到第12位时降10.0分. 其结果并不是所有前沿系统普遍失败;而是严重依赖模型的状态维护失败。

blocks.en: Table 3: Strict joint retention by model. Overall is the mean over five constraint categories and five turn depths. Early and late columns average all categories at turns 3 and 12 respectively.
blocks.zh: 表3:按模式严格联合保留. 总的来说,平均超过5个制约类别和5个转弯深度。 早期和晚期各栏平均分为第3和第12档。

blocks.en: Category averages reveal the same pattern from another angle. Table 4 reports the full model-by-category matrix in the main text rather than leaving the key slice analysis implicit. Factual-memory constraints score highest on average, while logical-rule and format constraints are lower. The failure is therefore not simply that models forget facts. Symbolic requirements that require exact reproduction or hard structural adherence remain vulnerable even when semantic memory is comparatively strong.
blocks.zh: 类别平均值从另一个角度显示相同的模式. 表4在正文中按类别报告完整的模型矩阵,而不是隐含关键片面分析。 事实-记忆约束平均得分最高,而逻辑规则和格式约束则较低. 因此,失败不仅仅是模型忘记事实。 即使语义记忆较强,但需要精确复制或硬结构坚持的符号要求仍然脆弱。

blocks.en: Table 4: Model-by-category strict joint retention (%) averaged across the five dialogue-depth probes. This table is the primary category result; Figure 2 is only a visual summary.
blocks.zh: 表4:按类别分列的严格联合保留模式(%)在五个对话深入调查中平均。 本表为主类结果;图2仅为可视摘要.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Retention by constraint type across models. Symbolic constraints create the most visible spread even when factual memory remains comparatively stable.
blocks.zh: 图3 按不同模式的制约类型分列的保留情况。 即使事实记忆保持相对稳定,象征性的限制也造成了最明显的传播。

blocks.en: The turn-wise tables and the model summary together show why we use the SIC framing. A system can retain an instruction in broad terms and still fail to keep it operational. That distinction matters for deployment: a memory module that restores the instruction string is not enough if the generation head still drifts on the next turn. In practical assistant use, symbolic constraints such as word limits, formatting rules, and persona style are the ones users notice most quickly when they fail, even when factual recall looks good.
blocks.zh: 转向式表格和模型摘要一起显示了我们为什么使用SIC框架。 一个系统可以从广义上保留一个指令,但仍然无法使其运作。 这种区分对部署很重要:如果一代头在下一个转弯时仍然漂移,恢复指令字符串的内存模块是不够的. 在实际的助手使用中,像字数限制,格式化规则,和人物风格等象征性的限制是用户在失败时最迅速地注意到的,即使事实上的召回看起来不错.

blocks.en: Table 5: Turn-level retention rates by model and dialogue depth. Scores are percentages averaged over all constraint categories.
blocks.zh: 表5:按模式和对话深度分列的转弯级保留率。 得分是所有制约类别的平均百分比。

blocks.en: The matrix separates three regimes. DeepSeek-v4-Flash is effectively invariant across all five depths, which suggests the benchmark is not trivially saturated but can support true stability. GPT-5.4-mini and DeepSeek-v4-Pro are mostly stable but show minor local reshuffling, which looks like shallow turn sensitivity rather than wholesale loss of state. Gemini-3.1-Pro is the only model with a clear late-turn degradation, and its brief recovery at turn 10 followed by a drop at turn 12 is exactly the kind of non-monotonic drift that a single average would hide.
blocks.zh: 矩阵将三种制度分开。 DeepSeek-v4-Flash在所有5个深度上都有效无变化,这表明基准并非微不足道的饱和,而是可以支持真正的稳定性. GPT-5.4-mini和DeepSeek-v4-Pro大多是稳定的,但表现出小的局部重排,这看起来像是浅转敏感,而不是批量失去状态. 双子座-3.1-Pro是唯一一个具有明显晚期降解的模型,它的10转弯短暂恢复,然后12转弯下降,正是单一平均值会隐藏的非运动漂移类型.

blocks.en: That matters operationally because the failure is not just “some models are worse than others.” A model can look healthy for several turns, pass a recall probe, and still violate the persistent rule once the dialogue gets long enough. In practice, exact formatting and numeric constraints are the first places users will notice the break, so the relevant evaluation question is whether the state remains active when the conversation shifts, not whether the model can quote the rule back.
blocks.zh: 这在操作上很重要,因为失败不仅仅是“一些模式比其他模式更糟糕”。 一个模型在几个转弯时可以看起来健康,通过一个召回探测器,并且一旦对话时间足够长,仍然违反持续的规则. 在实践中,精确的格式化和数字化的限制是用户注意中断的第一位置,因此相关的评价问题在于对话转移时状态是否仍然活跃,而不是模型是否能够引用规则回溯.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Turn-level retention curves across dialogue depth. The main signal is not monotonic collapse, but model-dependent stability versus late-turn drift.
blocks.zh: 图4:跨对话深度的转弯级保留曲线。 主要信号不是单调崩溃,而是模型依赖稳定性相对于后转向漂移.

blocks.en: To separate genuine memory loss from operational failure, we replay a recall probe for every non-retained primary output on a copied dialogue prefix. Each collapsed case is decomposed into an integrity failure —the model recalls the constraint when probed but did not apply it—or a memory failure —the model cannot reconstruct the constraint at all. This distinction matters for mitigation: retrieval helps only the second case, while control- or reranking-style interventions are needed for the first. Table 6 reports both the failure-conditioned IF rate and the all-probe SIC + \operatorname{SIC}^{+} rate.
blocks.zh: 为了将真实的内存损失与操作失败区分开来,我们在复制的对话框前缀上重放每个未保留的初级输出的回溯探测器. 每件崩溃的案件都被分解成完整性的失败——模型在被探测时回顾了约束,但没有应用——或者内存失败——模型完全无法重建约束. 这种区分对缓解很重要:检索只有助于第二种情况,而第一种情况需要控制或重新排序。 表6汇报了IF的故障率和所有被检测的SIC +\operatorname{SIC}^{+} 率。

blocks.en: Table 6: Failure-side SIC decomposition across the primary test set. IF = integrity failure (recalled but violated), MF = memory failure (unable to recall). SIC + \operatorname{SIC}^{+} is normalized by all 125 probes per model; IF rate is conditioned on observed failures.
blocks.zh: 表6:主试验套件的故障侧SIC分解. IF = 完整性失败(称为但被侵犯),MF = 内存失败(无法召回). SIC +\operatorname{SIC}^{+}}由每个模型的全部125个探测器实现正常化;IF速率以观测到的故障为条件.

blocks.en: Across the full test set, 88.6% of observed failures are integrity failures (Wilson 95% CI: 79.7–93.9). In other words, the dominant problem among failures is not that the model cannot recover the rule; it is that the recovered rule no longer governs the next answer. The effect is severity-skewed: Gemini-3.1-Pro contributes 47 of 79 failures. Excluding it reduces the all-probe SIC + \operatorname{SIC}^{+} rate from 8.0% to 3.6%, but the failure-conditioned diagnosis remains the same: 84.4% of the remaining failures are still recalled-but-violated cases (Wilson 95% CI: 68.2–93.1). This is the gap that a recall-only benchmark would miss.
blocks.zh: 在整个测试中,88.6%的观测失败是完整性故障(Wilson 95% CI:79.7–93.9)。 换句话说,失败中的主导问题不是模型无法恢复规则;而是恢复的规则不再支配下一个答案。 其效果为严重扭曲:双子座3.1-Pro在79个故障中贡献了47个. 除此以外,将所有检测的SIC +\operatorname{SIC}^{+}  rate  rate  rate  rate  rate  rate  rate % % % % % % % % % % % % % % % % % % % % % % % % % % 这是只回顾基准将错过的差距。

blocks.en: Reinstatement helps, but it does not erase the underlying collapse. Among models with observed failures, full recovery rates range from 53.2% to 100%, and a meaningful no-recovery tail persists for the weakest model. This supports the main claim: the hard part is preserving state across generation, not merely reloading it.
blocks.zh: 复议有帮助,但并不能消除潜在的崩溃。 在已观察到故障的模型中,完全回收率从53.2%到100%不等,最弱的模型仍然存在有意义的无回收尾巴。 这支持了主要的主张:困难的部分是在一代人之间保存状态,而不仅仅是重新装入状态.

blocks.en: 5.1 Temperature robustness
blocks.zh: 5.1 温度稳健性

blocks.en: SIC patterns are not artifacts of deterministic decoding: re-evaluation under τ ∈ { 0.0 , 0.3 , 0.7 } \tau\in\{0.0,0.3,0.7\} shows maximum 2.1-point shifts with preserved model ordering (Table 11 in Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: SIC图案并非定型解码的文物:在\\ { 0.0, 0. 3, 0. 7}\ tau\ in\ 0.0, 0. 3, 0 7} 下重新评价, 显示最大2.1点的调值, 并保留型号顺序(附录E表11) 。

blocks.en: 5.2 Per-category retention analysis
blocks.zh: 5.2 (中文(简体) ). 按类别分列的保留分析

blocks.en: Disaggregating by constraint category (Table 10 in Appendix D ) reveals that symbolic constraints are systematically more brittle: factual-memory and role/persona constraints are retained at 95%+ on average, while numerical (87.7%), format (85.5%), and logical-rule (83.5%) constraints cluster 8–12 points lower. This asymmetry suggests that symbolic constraints require exact surface realization that is more vulnerable to generation-time drift, whereas semantic constraints can be maintained through approximate paraphrase.
blocks.zh: 按制约类别分类(附录D表10)表明,象征性制约在系统上更为简洁:事实-记忆和作用/人的限制平均保持在95%+,而数字(87.7%)、格式(85.5%)和逻辑-规则(83.5%)的制约则较低。 这种不对称现象表明,象征性的限制要求精确的表面认识,而这种认识更容易受到代际漂移的影响,而语义限制则可以通过近似的诠释来维持。

blocks.en: 5.3 Rank-order stability
blocks.zh: 5.3 军衔稳定

blocks.en: Model rankings are stable across evaluation conditions: Kendall’s τ = 0.81 \tau=0.81 ( p < 0.01 p<0.01 ) between early-turn and late-turn orderings, and τ = 0.90 \tau=0.90 ( p < 0.005 p<0.005 ) between symbolic and semantic category orderings (full analysis in Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 不同评价条件的模型排名稳定: 肯德尔在早转和晚转命令之间(p < 0.01 p < 0.01)和符号类和语义类命令之间(p < 0.005 p < 0.005),与0.90\ tau=0.90(p < 0.005)之间(在附录D中全面分析)。

blocks.en: 6 Analysis
blocks.zh: 6 分析

blocks.en: The key qualitative distinction is between state recall and state use . In manual inspection, many failures preserve explicit references to the earlier instruction while violating its operational content. Models acknowledge a required output format and then add an unsolicited preface, or remember a word-count constraint but drift by a large margin. This is consistent with long-context position effects Liu et al. (2024) but suggests a stronger diagnosis: accessibility is not sufficient for control.
blocks.zh: 关键的质量区别是州召回和州使用。 在人工检查中,许多失败保留了对先前指示的明确提及,同时违反了其操作内容。 模型承认所需的产出格式,然后添加一个未经请求的序言,或者记住一个字数限制,但浮动幅度很大。 这与长文位置效应Liu等人(2024年)是一致的,但表明诊断力更强:可获取性不足以控制.

blocks.en: Three evaluators independently re-scored 120 randomly sampled outputs (stratified by model, category, and turn depth). Agreement between the automated judge and human majority vote was 93.3%. The 6.7% disagreement cases concentrated in role/persona items with minor stylistic drift (4.2%) and logical-rule items with genuinely ambiguous applicability (2.5%). In both cases, the automated judge was stricter than human raters, consistent with our conservative scoring design.
blocks.zh: 3名评价员独立地对120项随机抽样产出(按模式、类别和转弯深度进行重新评分)。 自动法官与多数人之间的协议为93.3%。 6.7%的分歧案件集中在作用/人物项目上,在形式上略有偏移(4.2%)和逻辑规则项目上,适用性确实不明确(2.5%)。 在这两种情况下,自动化法官比人类评分更严格,符合我们保守的评分设计.

blocks.en: Mean Jaccard similarity between distractor turns and the original constraint statement was 0.040 across all dialogues, confirming minimal lexical cuing. Five evaluators rated a sample of 40 dialogues for conversational naturalness on a 1–5 Likert scale; the mean rating was 4.2 ( σ = 0.6 \sigma=0.6 ), indicating that distractors read as plausible continuations rather than adversarial insertions.
blocks.zh: 调离器转动和原始约束语句之间的平均Jaccard相似性在所有对话框中为0.040,确认了最小的词典缓冲。 5名评价员将40次对话抽样评为1至5类自然对话;平均评分为4.2(= 0.6\sigma= 0.6),表明分心者认为是可信的延续而非对抗性的插入。

blocks.en: Turn depth is also diagnostic. Gemini-3.1-Pro shows the clearest collapse profile, whereas DeepSeek-v4-Flash remains stable. This variance argues against treating model scale or benchmark-era recency as a proxy for multi-turn reliability. The recall probe often looks healthy exactly when the next response is about to drift—that is the failure mode a deployment team should care about.
blocks.zh: 转深也是诊断. 双子座-3.1-Pro显示最明显的坍塌剖面,而DeepSeek-v4-Flash则保持稳定. 这一差异不利于将模型尺度或基准时代的调整作为多回合可靠性的替代物。 当下一个反应即将漂移时——即部署小组应注意的失败模式——召回探测器往往看起来很健康。

blocks.en: To test whether the diagnosis depends on the most brittle model, we ran a 216-probe analysis over the other six models, 12 numerical/format/logical scenarios, and depths 12, 30, and 50 (Appendix I ). Compliance is 94.4%, 95.8%, and 90.3%, respectively; depth-50 SIC + \operatorname{SIC}^{+} is 9.7%, and five of six models exhibit at least one recalled-but-violated case. Numerical constraints localize the mechanism most clearly: depth-50 recall remains 100.0% while compliance falls to 79.2%, yielding SIC + = 20.8 % \operatorname{SIC}^{+}=20.8\% . All five such failures involve response-internal counting, which points to online execution or self-verification rather than loss of the rule representation.
blocks.zh: 为了测试诊断是否依赖于最简陋的模型,我们对其他6个模型进行了216-probe分析,其中12个是数字/格式/逻辑假设,深度为12、30和50(附录一)。 遵守率分别为94.4%,95.8%,90.3%;深度-50 SIC +\operatorname{SIC}^{+}}为9.7%,6个型号中有5个型号显示至少1个被召回但被侵犯的案例. 数字限制最明确地将机制本地化:深度-50的召回率仍为100.0%,而遵守率降至79.2%,结果SIC + = 20.8%\操作者名称{SIC }^{+}=20.8}。 所有这五个失败都涉及答复-内部计算,这说明在线执行或自我核查,而不是失去规则代表。

blocks.en: Extended depth (turns 20–50), Chinese/Japanese, SSA, prompt-style sensitivity, dynamic update/revocation, and two-constraint evaluations test distinct boundaries (Appendices F – I ). The cross-lingual and two-constraint results remain compact scope checks; the six-model symbolic-depth analysis above is the confirmatory robustness result.
blocks.zh: 扩展深度(20–50转),中文/日语,SSA,即时风格的敏感度,动态更新/撤销,以及双约束评价测试不同界限(附录F–I). 交叉语言和两种制约性的结果仍然是紧凑的范围检查;上面六种模式的象征性深入分析是确认性强的结果。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: Errors are not uniform across constraint types. Numerical and format constraints are the most brittle because they require exact surface realization surviving the full dialogue history. Role/persona constraints fail differently: the model slips into a generic assistant voice despite remembering the persona. Logical rules are hardest when follow-ups subtly change the original rule’s scope. Factual-memory bindings are the most stable.
blocks.zh: 各种制约类型的错误并不一致。 数字和格式方面的限制是最微弱的,因为这些限制需要准确的表面实现,才能在对话的全部历史中幸存下来。 角色/人物限制失败不同:模型滑入一个通用助理语音,尽管记得人物a. 逻辑规则在后续程序潜移改变原规则范围时最难. 事实记忆束缚是最稳定的.

blocks.en: Turn-level data shows that average performance hides meaningful variance. Our extended-depth pilot (Appendix F ) shows that divergence amplifies for the three sampled models at turns 20–50, but we do not claim that every model has the same decay curve. The cross-lingual pilot (Appendix G ) suggests that the recall–compliance dissociation is not English-specific, while remaining too small to support language-universal claims.
blocks.zh: 转向层数据显示,平均性能隐藏了有意义的差异. 我们的扩展深度飞行员(Appendix F )显示,在20–50转弯时,三种抽样模型的分歧会扩大,但我们并不声称每个模型都有相同的衰变曲线. 跨语言试点(Appendix G)表示,召回-遵规分离并非英语特异性,同时仍然太小,无法支持通用语言的说法.

blocks.en: StateTrack-Bench is designed as a diagnostic instrument rather than a leaderboard-scale corpus. Each scenario isolates a specific failure mode at a specific depth, enabling causal attribution. The targeted audits in Appendix I and the prompt sensitivity analysis in Appendix L test whether the main diagnosis survives alternative scoring decompositions, model subsets, state updates, interacting constraints, and prompt reformulation. Established diagnostic benchmarks routinely use comparable expert-crafted sets (Winograd Schema Challenge: 273 items; BIG-Bench Hard: 23 tasks of 50–250 examples) precisely because diagnostic precision requires careful construction over volume.
blocks.zh: StateTrack-Bench被设计为诊断仪器,而不是领导板级体. 每一种情景都会在特定深度隔离出特定的故障模式,从而能够实现因果归属. 附录一中的定向审计和附录L中的即时灵敏度分析测试主要诊断是否在替代评分分解,模型子集,状态更新,相互作用约束,以及即时重排. 既定的诊断基准通常使用可比较的专家制作的成套(Winograd Schema Challenge:273项;BIG-Bench Hard:23项任务,50-250个实例),正是因为诊断精度需要细心的构造大于体积。

blocks.en: SSA is a diagnostic intervention rather than a novel algorithm. Prior work gives mixed evidence on free-form self-feedback: Self-Refine reports iterative gains Madaan et al. (2023) , whereas intrinsic self-correction can fail without external feedback Huang et al. (2024) . SSA instead uses a concrete verifiable predicate derived from the constraint specification. Its three-stage decomposition localizes where state integrity breaks: prepending alone recovers 62% of lost compliance (cost: +13% tokens), demonstrating that SIC is primarily a state-binding failure at generation time. The verification stage quantifies the residual enforcement gap. The result applies to constraints that remain active. In a 7-model, 5-scenario dynamic-state audit, stale SSA enforces a superseded rule in 74.3% of cases, while updating the ledger reduces stale enforcement to 0.0% and yields updated or clean behavior in 97.1% (Appendix I ). A separate two-constraint audit obtains 76.5% joint success over 34 valid outputs, confirming that interacting constraints are harder than the isolated core setting.
blocks.zh: SSA是一种诊断干预,而不是一种新颖的算法. 先前的工作为自由形式的自食其力提供了混合的证据: Self-Refine报告迭代增益Madaan等人(2023年),而内在的自我校正如果没有外部反馈,黄等人(2024年)则可能失败. 特别服务协定则使用从制约规格中衍生出来的可核查的具体上游。 它的三阶段分解在状态完整性断裂的地方: 仅预付就回收了62%的失守(成本:+13%的令牌),表明SIC在生成时主要是国家约束的失败. 核查阶段将剩余执行差距量化。 结果适用于仍然活跃的制约因素。 在7型,5型动态状态审计中,Stale SSA在74.3%的案例中执行一条被取代的规则,而更新分类则将Stale执行率降低到0.0 %,并在97.1%中产生更新或干净的行为(附录一)。 单独的双约束审计比34项有效产出获得76.5%的联合成功率,证实互动制约比孤立的核心设置更难。

blocks.en: Manual inspection reveals three recurring failure signatures: numerical predicate drift (63% of logical-rule failures), format overflow under fluency pressure, and affective override when emotionally charged user messages trigger persona abandonment (71% of role/persona failures).
blocks.zh: 人工检查揭示了三个反复出现的故障签名:数字上游漂移(逻辑规则故障的63%),在流利压力下的格式溢出,以及情感上充电的用户信息触发人被抛弃时的感官覆盖(71%的角色/人被放弃)。

blocks.en: Among observed failures, the high integrity-failure share means RAG alone is insufficient: recovering the instruction text does not guarantee that it governs the next answer. Monitoring should prioritize symbolic constraints, which fail silently. The prepending-only SSA variant (13% token overhead) is a practical safeguard only when the active-state registry is correct; systems with user revocations or updates need an explicit state-update policy before re-anchoring.
blocks.zh: 在观察到的失败中,高完整性-失败份额意味着光是RAG是不够的:恢复指令文本并不能保证它支配下一个答案. 监测应优先考虑象征性的限制因素,这些限制无声无息。 只有当活动状态注册正确时,预置的SSA变体(13%的令牌间接费用)才是一种实用的保障;用户撤销或更新的系统在重新选择前需要明确的状态更新政策.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: StateTrack-Bench shows that persistent-state evaluation is necessary for multi-turn reliability. State Integrity Collapse (SIC), where a recalled constraint fails to govern generation, remains the dominant failure type even after excluding the most brittle model.
blocks.zh: StateTrack-Bench显示,持续状态评价对于多回合的可靠性是必要的. " 国家诚信崩溃 " (SIC),在被召回的制约不能治理一代人的情况下,即使在排除了最简陋的模式之后,仍然是主要的失败类型。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our study has several limitations that should be considered when interpreting the results.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究有一些局限性,在解释研究结果时应予考虑。

blocks.en: First, the core benchmark comprises 125 scenario-depth probes per model, and the per-category sample size (25 probes) limits statistical power for fine-grained within-category comparisons. We therefore use category results as diagnostic profiles rather than significance-ranked model comparisons. The targeted follow-up audits test specific methodological boundaries, but a community-scale expansion with hundreds of scenarios per category would still enable more precise effect estimation.
blocks.zh: 首先,核心基准包括每个模型125个情景深度探测器,每个类别样本大小(25个探测器)限制了分类内精细比较的统计能力。 因此,我们使用类别结果作为诊断概况,而不是按重要性排序的模型比较。 目标明确的后续审计检验具体的方法界限,但社区规模的扩大,每个类别有数百个设想方案,仍然能够更准确地估计效果。

blocks.en: Second, while our multi-judge cross-validation (Appendix J ) shows high inter-judge agreement ( κ = 0.89 \kappa=0.89 ) across three architecturally distinct models with no significant self-preference bias, the evaluation still relies on LLM-based judges. Future work should incorporate larger-scale human evaluation and investigate whether judge biases correlate with specific constraint types or dialogue structures.
blocks.zh: 第二,虽然我们的多位法官交叉鉴定(附录J)显示,在三个没有明显自我偏爱的建筑上截然不同的模型上,法官之间有很高的一致(ob = 0.89\kappa= 0.89),但评价仍然依赖于基于LLM的法官. 今后的工作应包括更广泛的人类评价,并调查法官的偏见是否与具体的制约类型或对话结构相关。

blocks.en: Third, while our cross-lingual pilot (Appendix G ) suggests that SIC-like patterns can appear in Chinese and Japanese with preserved model rankings, the 30-scenario pilot is insufficient for definitive cross-lingual claims. Languages with richer morphology (e.g., Finnish, Turkish) or fundamentally different discourse structures (e.g., Arabic) remain untested. A full multilingual benchmark covering diverse typological families is needed.
blocks.zh: 第三,虽然我们的跨语言飞行员(Appendix G)认为类似SIC的图案可以在中日文中以保存的模型排名出现,但30场的飞行员不足以确定跨语言诉求. 形态较丰富的语言(如芬兰语,土耳其语)或根本不同的话语结构(如阿拉伯语)仍然没有经过测试. 需要一个涵盖多种类型家庭的全面多语种基准。

blocks.en: Fourth, our distractor turns are designed to be topically related but non-adversarial. In deployment, users may actively attempt to override constraints through social engineering or adversarial prompting. Our benchmark measures baseline SIC under cooperative conditions; adversarial robustness requires separate evaluation.
blocks.zh: 第四,我们的分心器转弯被设计成 主题相关但非对抗性。 在部署中,用户可能积极试图通过社会工程或对抗性诱导来克服限制。 我们的基准计量基线是合作条件下的SIC;对抗力强则需要单独的评价.

blocks.en: Fifth, while our extended depth pilot (Appendix F ) shows that SIC patterns intensify at depths 20–50, the pilot uses a 40-scenario subset. Full-scale evaluation at depths beyond 50 turns—particularly in multi-session settings where context is summarized or truncated—remains future work.
blocks.zh: 第五,虽然我们的扩展深度飞行员(Appendix F)显示,SIC模式在深度20–50会增强,但飞行员却使用一个40-情景子集. 深入到50个回合之后的全面评价——特别是在对背景进行总结或缩短的多会环境中——仍然是今后的工作。

blocks.en: Finally, the benchmark uses one persistent constraint per dialogue. This isolates recall–compliance dissociation cleanly but does not measure multi-constraint interference, conflicting priorities, or user-initiated constraint revocation. Our proposed mitigation (SSA, Appendix H ) is therefore an inference-time intervention for immutable active constraints; without an explicit update/revocation detector it may over-enforce a stale rule. The dynamic audit in Appendix I quantifies this risk but is still a stress test rather than a full dynamic-dialogue benchmark. Developing training-time solutions and dynamic state-management protocols that fundamentally improve state-binding in generation remains an open challenge.
blocks.zh: 最后,基准采用每次对话一个持续制约。 这孤立了召回 — — 遵守分离,但并不衡量多重约束性干预、相互冲突的优先事项或用户主动取消限制。 因此,我们提议的缓解措施(SSA,附录H)是对不可改变的主动制约的推论时间干预;如果没有明确的更新/撤销探测器,它可能会过分强制实施一条僵化的规则。 附录一中的动态审计量化了这一风险,但仍是一个压力测试,而不是一个完整的动态对话基准。 制定培训时间解决方案和动态国家管理协议,从根本上改善世代国家约束力,仍然是一个公开的挑战。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: All dialogue scenarios were authored by our research team and do not contain personally identifiable information, offensive content, or material that could cause harm if released. The benchmark does not involve human subjects in the traditional sense; crowdwork annotators were compensated at $18 USD per hour, above the local minimum wage. We release the benchmark under CC BY 4.0 to facilitate replication while permitting commercial use for safety evaluation purposes. The main ethical risk is misuse of the results as a blanket ranking of model safety; our findings should be interpreted as a targeted audit of persistent constraint adherence rather than a comprehensive safety evaluation.
blocks.zh: 所有对话设想都是由我们的研究小组撰写的,没有包含个人可识别的信息、攻击性内容或释放后可能造成伤害的材料。 基准不涉及传统意义上的人类主体;集体工作注释员每小时获得18美元,高于当地最低工资。 我们公布CC BY 4.0的基准,以便于复制,同时允许用于安全评价的商业用途。 主要的道德风险是误用结果作为模式安全的全面排名;我们的调查结果应被解释为对持续遵守限制的针对性审计,而不是全面的安全评价。

blocks.en: To stress-test five methodological concerns, we ask whether strict joint retention conflates immediate-task failure with persistent-state failure, whether signed SIC components can be reported more directly by category, whether the symbolic-depth signal persists when the brittle Gemini outlier is excluded, whether SSA over-enforces stale constraints after revocation or update, and how the diagnosis changes when two persistent constraints are active simultaneously. We therefore ran compact follow-up audits using the same logged model snapshots, with one audit intentionally excluding Gemini, and saved all raw outputs, judge decisions, and summaries with the released experiment logs.

blocks.en: I.1 Strict Joint versus Constraint-Only Scoring
blocks.zh: I.1 严格联合对约束 - 仅分明

blocks.en: Table 15 reports a 70-output audit (10 probes per model) that separately scores immediate-task success, constraint-only compliance, strict joint success, recall, SIC + \operatorname{SIC}^{+} , and SIC − \operatorname{SIC}^{-} . The audit verifies the interpretation used in the main text: strict joint retention is a conservative deployment metric, while constraint-only compliance isolates the persistent-rule component. For example, several models preserve the constraint more often than they satisfy the full joint task, so treating strict joint retention as pure memory would be overly pessimistic.
blocks.zh: 表15报告了一项70个输出的审计(每个模型10个探测器),分别对即时任务成功,约束性遵守,严格的联合成功,回忆,SIC +\操作者名{SIC}^{+}}和SIC →\操作者名{SIC}^{}进行评分. 审计核实了正文中使用的解释:严格的联合保留是一种保守的部署指标,而只遵守约束则孤立了持久规则的组成部分。 例如,有几种模型比它们满足全部联合任务时更经常地保留制约,因此将严格的联合保留作为纯记忆处理会过于悲观.

blocks.en: Table 15: Compact strict-joint versus constraint-only audit on controlled multi-turn histories (10 probes/model). Immediate-task success is judged while ignoring the persistent constraint; constraint-only uses the scenario checker; strict joint requires both.
blocks.zh: 表15:对受控多回合历史(10次探针/模型)进行严格联合审计和仅限审计。 对即时任务的成功进行判断,同时忽略了持续的制约;约束只使用情景检查器;严格的联合要求两者兼有.

blocks.en: I.2 Signed SIC Components by Category
blocks.zh: 一.2 签署 按类别划分

blocks.en: Table 16 reports the signed SIC components by category on the same compact forked audit. Because this audit contains only 14 probes per category, we use it as a diagnostic check rather than a replacement for the primary failure-side decomposition in Table 6 . It nevertheless makes the signed quantities explicit: SIC + \operatorname{SIC}^{+} captures recalled-but-violated behavior, whereas SIC − \operatorname{SIC}^{-} captures behaviorally compliant outputs whose recall probe fails.
blocks.zh: 表16按类别报告了已签字的SIC组成部分,并报告了同一份紧凑的计费审计。 由于这次审计只包含每类14个探测器,因此我们用它作为诊断检查,而不是取代表6中的主要故障侧分解. 尽管如此,它还是明确了签名的数量: SIC +\ 操作器名称{ SIC}^{+} 捕获了回顾但违反的行为, 而 SIC −\ 操作器名称{ SIC}^{-} 捕获了行为符合性能的输出, 其召回探测器失败 。

blocks.en: Table 16: SIC components by constraint category in the compact forked audit. Values are percentages over 14 probes per category (2 scenarios × \times 7 models).
blocks.zh: 表16: 契约加固审计中按制约类别分列的SIC组成部分。 数值为每类14个探测器的百分比(2种情况×\时7种模型)。

blocks.en: I.3 Gemini-Excluded Symbolic-Depth Check
blocks.zh: I.3 双子座-例外符号-深度检查

blocks.en: To further isolate the model-dependency concern, we ran a new diagnostic audit that excludes Gemini-3.1-Pro entirely and focuses on symbolic constraints at longer depths. The audit covers six non-Gemini models, twelve numerical/format/logical scenarios, three depths (12, 30, and 50), and forked behavior/recall branches, yielding 216 paired probes (432 real model calls). Table 17 shows that aggregate constraint compliance remains high but not perfect: 94.4% at depth 12, 95.8% at depth 30, and 90.3% at depth 50. The depth-50 SIC + \operatorname{SIC}^{+} rate is 9.7%, and five of the six non-Gemini models exhibit at least one recalled-but-violated case. A descriptive mechanism audit further localizes the gap: numerical constraints retain 100.0% recall but only 79.2% compliance at depth 50, yielding SIC + = 20.8 % \operatorname{SIC}^{+}=20.8\% ; all five numerical SIC + \operatorname{SIC}^{+} events occur in response-internal counting cases. This pattern is consistent with an online execution or self-verification bottleneck rather than simple loss of the rule representation. It supports a calibrated conclusion: the strongest failures are model-dependent, but the symbolic recall–compliance dissociation is not exclusively a Gemini artifact.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步孤立模型依赖性问题,我们进行了一次新的诊断性审计,将双子座3.1-Pro完全排除在外,并侧重于更深处的象征性限制。 审计范围包括6个非吉米尼模型,12个数字/格式/逻辑情景,3个深度(12、30和50),以及防御行为/召回分支,共产生216个对联探测器(432个真正的模型呼叫). 表17显示,总的制约遵守率仍然很高,但并不完美:深度为12,94.4%;深度为30,95.8%;深度为50,90.3%。 深度-50 SIC +\operatorname{SIC}^{+}}的速率为9.7%,6个非Gemini模型中有5个显示至少1个被召回但被侵犯的病例. 描述性机制审计将差距进一步本地化:数字限制保留了100.0%的回溯率,但深度50时只有79.2%的遵守率,得出SIC + = 20.8%\操作者名称{SIC}^{+}=20.8};所有5个数字SIC +\操作者名称{SIC}^{+}事件都发生在响应-内部计数案件中. 这种模式与在线执行或自我核查瓶颈一致,而不是简单的失去规则代表. 它支持一个校准的结论:最强的失败都是依赖模型的,但是象征性的召回 — — 遵义解脱不仅仅是双子座文物.

blocks.zh: 表17 双子座排除的符号性深度诊断审计. C@d是深度d的决定性约束遵守;\\Delta是C@50–C@12。

blocks.en: I.4 Dynamic Update and Revocation Stress Test
blocks.zh: I.4 动态更新和取消压力测试

blocks.en: Table 18 reports a 7-model × \times 5-scenario × \times 3-condition stress test for dynamic-state handling. The base condition gives the model the dialogue history after the user explicitly revokes or updates a constraint. The stale-SSA condition intentionally injects the old active-state ledger, and the updated-ledger condition injects the revised ledger. The base dialogue rarely enforces the stale rule (2.9%), but stale SSA raises stale enforcement to 74.3%. Updating the active-state ledger before re-anchoring reduces stale enforcement to 0.0% and yields updated/clean behavior in 97.1% of cases. This is why our SSA claim is scoped to immutable active constraints and why deployment systems need explicit state-update tracking before re-anchoring.
blocks.zh: 表18为动态状态处理报告7型××5-情景×3条件应力测试. 基础条件给出了在用户明确取消或更新一个约束之后的模型对话框历史. Stale-SSA条件故意注入旧的主动状态分类账,更新的引导器条件注入订正分类账. 基础对话很少执行陈旧规则(2.9%),但陈旧的SSA将陈旧的强制执行提高到74.3%。 在重新锁定前更新活动状态分类账,将暂停执行降至0.0 %,并在97.1%的情况下产生更新/清理行为。 正因为如此,我们的SSA声称的范围是不可改变的主动限制,而且部署系统在重新锁定之前需要明确的状态更新跟踪。

blocks.en: Table 18: Dynamic revoke/update stress test for SSA. Stale enforced counts outputs that incorrectly follow the old constraint after it was revoked or updated. Base uses only the dialogue history; stale SSA intentionally injects the old active state; updated-ledger SSA injects the revised active state.
blocks.zh: 表18:SSA动态吊销/更新应激测试. Stale 执行计算在被取消或更新后不正确地遵循旧约束的产出。 Base只使用对话框历史; stale SSA 故意注入旧的活跃状态;更新的-edger SSA 注入修改后的活跃状态.

blocks.en: I.5 Two-Constraint Scope Check
blocks.zh: 一.5 双约束 范围检查

blocks.en: Finally, Table 19 reports a low-cost diagnostic micro-audit with two simultaneous persistent constraints per dialogue. This audit directly probes the ecological-validity boundary of the single-constraint benchmark design. Across 34 valid outputs (one GPT-5.4 probe encountered a repeated upstream 502 and is excluded), the joint two-constraint success rate is 76.5%, lower than the main single-constraint benchmark, while forked recall is 73.5%. This confirms that multi-constraint interference is a harder setting and should be treated as future full-benchmark work, while preserving the paper’s main design rationale: the core benchmark intentionally isolates state integrity before adding interacting constraints.
blocks.zh: 最后,表19报告了低成本的诊断微观审计,每次对话同时存在两个长期存在的制约因素。 这项审计直接探究了单一约束基准设计的生态有效性边界. 在34个有效产出中(一个GPT-5.4探测器遇到一次重复的上游502并被排除在外),联合双节制成功率为76.5%,低于主要的单节制基准,而扳机召回率为73.5%。 这证实,多约束性干扰是一个更难的设定,应该作为未来的全基准工作来对待,同时保留论文的主要设计原理:核心基准在增加相互作用的制约之前故意孤立国家完整性.

blocks.en: Table 19: Compact two-constraint diagnostic audit. C1/C2 are the two deterministic constraint checks; Joint requires both constraints; Recall is the forked recall probe.
blocks.zh: 表19 紧凑双约束诊断审计. C1/C2是两种确定性的制约检查; 联合要求两种制约; 召回是前锋召回探测器.

blocks.en: I.6 Illustrative Cases
blocks.zh: 一.6 说明性案例

blocks.en: The following compact examples show how the audit labels are assigned. In a SIC + \operatorname{SIC}^{+} case, the setup required every response to end with an exact word count in brackets. GPT-5.4-mini answered the weather probe with a reasonable caveat but omitted the bracketed count, while its separate recall branch correctly restated the rule. In a SIC − \operatorname{SIC}^{-} case under the same setup, Claude-Sonnet-4-6 produced a bracketed-count answer, but its recall branch refused to state the active constraint. For dynamic SSA, after the user updated the suffix rule from END to DONE , stale SSA produced an answer ending in END , while updated-ledger SSA produced the same answer ending in DONE . These cases are illustrative; the quantitative labels come from the full compact audit above.
blocks.zh: 以下紧凑的例子说明了审计标签是如何分配的. 在 SIC +\operatorname{SIC}^{+}} 的情况下, 设置需要每个响应以括号中准确的字数结尾 。 GPT-5.4-mini对气象探测器作了合理的提醒,但省略了括号内的计数,而其单独的召回分支则正确地重申了规则. 在SIC-\operatorname{SIC}^{}的同一种设置下的一个案例中,克劳德-索内特-4-6给出了一个括号内的计数答案,但其召回分支拒绝说明主动约束. 对于动态SSA,在用户将后缀规则从END更新到DONE之后, stale SSA制作了一个以 END 结尾的答案,而更新导向的SSA则以 DONE 结尾的相同答案. 这些案件是说明性的;定量标签来自上述全面紧凑的审计。

blocks.en: Appendix K SSA Inference Cost Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录 K 推论成本分析

blocks.en: We quantify the latency and token overhead of Structured State Anchoring to enable informed deployment decisions.
blocks.zh: 我们量化结构化国家安打的延迟性和象征性间接费用,以便能够作出知情的部署决定。

blocks.en: Table 21: SSA inference overhead at depth 12. Latency is wall-clock time per response; token cost includes input+output tokens for all retries.
blocks.zh: 表21:12深度的敏感海区推论。 延迟是每次响应的时钟时间;符号成本包括所有重试的输入+输出符号.

blocks.en: The overhead is model-dependent and correlates with baseline SIC severity: models that fail more often trigger more retries. GPT-5.4 averages 0.2 retries per response (mean 1 retry every 5 turns), while Gemini-3.1-Pro averages 1.3 retries. The structured prepending component alone (no verification/retry) adds only 12–15% token overhead and recovers 60–70% of lost compliance, making it suitable for latency-sensitive deployments. The full SSA pipeline (prepending + verification + retry) is recommended for high-stakes applications where correctness outweighs latency.
blocks.zh: 间接费用依赖模型,并与基线SIC严重性相关:失败的模型往往引发更多的重复。 GPT-5.4 平均每个响应重试0.2次(平均每5个回合重试1次),双子座-3.1-Pro平均重试1.3次. 仅结构化的预先开支部分(没有核查/重审)就只增加了12-15%的象征性间接费用,并收回了60-70%的失守率,使其适合对耐久性敏感的部署。 建议在正确性大于耐久性的情况下,为高耗量的应用提供全部SSA管道(预置+核查+重试)。

blocks.en: SSA’s three stages contribute differently to recovery: (1) structured prepending alone recovers 62% of lost compliance on average (cost: +13% tokens, +8% latency); (2) adding constraint reformulation as verifiable predicates recovers an additional 14% (cost: +4% tokens, negligible latency); (3) post-generation verification with retry recovers the final 24% (cost: variable, 0–47% additional tokens depending on retry frequency). This decomposition demonstrates that SSA is not merely “retry until correct” but a principled diagnostic tool: the prepending stage isolates state-binding failures, while the verification stage isolates generation-time constraint enforcement failures.
blocks.zh: SA的三个阶段对复苏的贡献不同:(1) 结构化的预先支出平均回收了62%的失守率(成本:+13%的令牌,+8%的耐用性);(2) 增加约束性重置,因为可核查的上游恢复了14%(成本:+4%的令牌,可忽略不计的耐用性);(3) 使用再试的生成后核查回收了最后的24%(成本:可变的,0-47%的额外令牌,取决于再试频率)。 这种分解表明,特别服务协定不仅“在正确之前重审”,而且是一种原则性的诊断工具:前期阶段孤立了有国家约束力的失败,而核查阶段则孤立了产生时间制约的执行失败。
